TITLE: Step 3: Select a representative sample set
INTRO: Select samples for evaluation. The notes that you took during exploration in the previous step are provided here to help you select the samples. Ensure that the samples selected are representative of the target digital product.
RESOURCE_LINK_NAME: Step 3: Select a Representative Sample Set
HD_ESSENT_FUNC: Essential functionality (optional notes from the previous step)
HD_VARIETY_PAGE_TYPES: Variety of sample types (optional notes from the previous step)
INF_STRUCT_SAMPLE:
Select samples that reflect all identified (1) common views, (2) essential functionality, (3) types of samples, (4) technologies relied upon, and (5) other relevant samples. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 3.a: Include a Structured Sample](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step3a).
**Note**: ‘Samples’ includes all different states within a sample; see the principle of [product enclosure](https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em-2/#principle-of-product-enclosure).
INF_RAND_SAMPLE:
Randomly select samples; select 10% of the structured sample set above. For more information, see [WCAG-EM Step 3.b: Include a Randomly Selected Sample](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/#step3b).
**Note**: ‘Samples’ includes all different states within a sample; see the principle of [product enclosure](https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em-2/#principle-of-product-enclosure).
RAND_SAMPLE_LENGTH: Based on your structured sample set of {STRUCTURED_SAMPLE_COUNT} samples, choose at least {REQUIRED_RANDOM_SAMPLE_COUNT} randomly selected samples (to meet the 10% requirement in WCAG-EM).
NO_PAGES_DEFINED: No samples defined for this list
DELETE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you would like to delete this sample?
